title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$4$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining $$3$$ parts are used for training.

title: Training and Validation in Cross-Validation
text: Each data point is used in the training set multiple times, specifically in all folds except the one where it is used as a validation set.

title: Number of Times Each Data Point is Used for Training
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, each data point is used for training $$3$$ times and for validation once.

title: Conclusion on the Statement
text: Given the explanation of 4-fold cross-validation, is the statement 'With $$4$$ folds, each data point is used for training exactly $$4$$ times' true or false?
